dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing of the body width originating from the mid-section and progressing toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous, exhibiting no visible localized bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white skin tone with uniform reflectance across the central dorsal field.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse greyish clusters localized around the cranial region and blowhole perimeter.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the pigmented cephalic region and the depigmented dorsal canvas.
